response.reason: The odd-power series for log(s) is truncated after the q^5/5 term; at the largest |q| (s=2, i.e. x≈0) the truncation error is ~1.3e-6, so output near x=0 misses softplus(0)=ln(2) by more than the required 1e-6 absolute tolerance (before even counting FP32 rounding).
